content: Jesusta huanchinata cuintanacushcamanda

Pascua nishca chi mana putasyachishca panda micuna jista pactarinagama ishcai (2) punzha pishira. Ñáa pagri amugunahuan Dios mandashcagunata yachachic runagunahuan cuintanacunaura imasna rashata Jesusta pacalla japishun huanchingahua nisha.
Shuccuna rimanaura, Jista punzhaibi japina mana balinzhu, runaguna ñucanchita piñangaunami ninaura.
Jesusta asnac yacuhuan armachishcamanda

Shuc punzha Betania llactai lepramanda janbishca Simon nishca runahua huasibi Jesus micuura. Micuupi shuc huarmi shamura yapa ali balic asnac yacu butita apamusha. Jesus tiyashcama pactasha chi butita pascasha Jesuspa uma jahuaibi talira.
Shuccuna chita ricusha piñarisha paigunapura rimanacunaura, Imangahuata chi yapa balic yacuta chasna yanga talin.
Chita randichishca acpiga shuc huata tarabashca cullquita yali llucshinmi pugri runagunata cumbirangahuaca. Chasna rimanacusha chi huarmita piñanaura.
Chasna rimaunaupi Jesus chi runagunata rimara, Chi huarmita ama piñaichichu, chasnalla saquichi. Pai rashcataga ñucaraicu alitami raun.
Pugri runagunaga tucui uras cangunahuan tiyaungunami, canguna munashcai paigunatas yanapanata ushanguichimi. Ñáucaga randi mana unaita cangunahuan tiyashachu.
Cai huarmiga pai ushashca tuputa rashcami. Ñáuca huañusha pambaitucunata yuyarishami chi yacuta ñuca aichai ñaupata talingahua shamuhuashca.
Sirtumi cangunata rimani, tucui partibi Diospa quishpina shimita camachiusha pai rashcatas cuintacpi pai yuyarishca anga nira.
Jesusta Judas japichishcamanda
Chi chunga ishcai (12) japishca runaguna shucca Judas Iscariotega, israel pagrigunata mandaccunahuagma rira paigunahuan cuintasha imasna Jesusta japichisha paigunama cungahua nisha.
Pai rimashcata uyasha pagri amuguna cushiyasha cullquita cushcangui ninaura. Chi urasmanda imasna rashata japichinata ushasha Judasca yuyarisha puriura.
Jesus puchucaita micushcamanda

Israelguna mana putasyachishca panda micuna jista punzhagunai, ña ovejata huanchina punzha pactashcai, Jesus japishca runaguna paita tapunaura, Maibita munangui pascua jistata ñucanchi micungahua alichigrinata.
Tapunaupi Jesus pai japishcapuramanda ishcaita cachara casna nisha, Llactama riusha shuc yacu mangata apauc runata tupangaraunguichi. Paitaga catinguichi.
Pai yaicushca huasiyuc amuta rimanguichi, Ñáucanchita yachachic ninmi, maibitan pasiana cuarto ñuca japishcagunandi pascuata yuyarisha micungahua.
Paiga jahua pataibi shuc jatun cuartota ricuchingami tucui ñucanchi minishtishcagunatas. Chibi micunata alichichi.
Rimacpi chi ishcai runaguna risha llactama pactasha Jesus rimashcacuinta tupanaura. Chasna acpi pascua micunata chillai alichinaura.
Ñáa indi yaicushcai Jesus pai chunga ishcai (12) japishcagunandi shamunaura.
Paiguna micuushcai rimara, Sirtumi cangunata nini, cangunamanda shucca ñucahuan pariu micuucca ñucata japichihuangaraun nira.
Chita uyasha huinguna yapa llaquirinaura. Caran shuc shuc tapunaura, Ñáucachani, ñucachu candaga japichina ani nicpi.
Paigunata nira, Canguna chunga ishcaipuramanda shucca cai pulatullaita ñucahuan pariu paihua panda satiu.
Dios ñucamanda quillcachishcacuintallata mana saquirisha ringarauni. Ai, chi ñucata japichiu runalla. Mana pagarishca ashaga ali anmara nira.
Paiguna micuunaupi Jesus panda japisha Diosta pagrachu nisha paquisha paigunama cuusha rimara, Japichi, caiga ñuca aicha man nira.
Huasha shuc vino yacuta jundachishca pillchita japisha Diosta pagrachu nisha paigunama pasachira tucuiguna upinauchun nisha.
Chasna rasha paigunata rimara, Caiga ñuca rahuaimi, Yaya Dios paihua runagunahuan mushuc pactachina shimita ricuchiu rahuaimi. Cai ñuca rahuai tucui runagunamanda talishca anga.
Sirtumi cangunata nini, vino yacuta mana cuti upishachu ñuca Yaya ali mandanai shuc mushuc vinota upinagama nira.
Ñáa paiguna micusha upishcahuasha Yaya Diosta alabasha cantanaura. Chihuasha Olivos nishca urcuma rinaura.
Pedro llullangaraushcata rimashcamanda
Riushcai paigunata nira, Cunan tuta tucui canguna ñucamanda anchuringaraunguichi. Diospa shimibi casnami nin: Cuiracta huanchicpiga ovejaguna sáa tucungaunami.
Chasna agllaita ñuca causarishami. Causarishcahuasha cangunata ñaupasha Galileama punda pactashami.
Pedro chita uyasha, Tucuiguna canmanda anchurinaupihuas ñucaga canda catishami nira.
Rimacpi Jesus nira, Pedro candaga sirtumi rimani, cunan tuta gallo chara mana ishcai (2) cutin cantagllaita can quimsa (3) cutin ñucamanda llullangaraungui paita mana ricsinichu nisha.
Pedro randi, Canhuan pariu huañuna ashahuas canmanda mana chasna llullashachu nisha sinzhita rimara. Tucui chi shuccunahuas chasnallata rimanaura.
Getsemaní nishca pambaibi Dioshuan cuintashcamanda
Chasna cuintanacushcahuasha Getsemaní nishca pambama rinaura. Chibi pactasha Jesus pai yachachiushcagunata nira, Caillai saquirichi, ñuca mas chinicshinai riuni Yaya Dioshuan cuintangahua.
Chasna nisha Pedrota, Santiagotas, Juandas mas chinicshinama pushasha rira. Chasna riushami pai yapa turbarisha llaquiricallarira.
Chasna tucusha paigunata nira, Ñáuca shungu ucuibi yapa llaquirishcamanda huañuunimi. Caillai saquirisha astallata chapahuaichi.
Rimasha mas chinigma risha tuhuama urmasha Yaya Diosta mañausha tapura cai tutaibi tucungaraushcata ñucamanda anchuchihuai nisha.

Chasnallata casnami Yaya Diosta tapura, Ñáuca Yaya, can tucuitami ushangui. Cunan cai jayacta upinashina sinzhi turmintarinata ñucamanda anchuchihuai Yaya. Randi ama ñuca munashcacuinta achun astahuanbas can munashcacuinta tucuchun nira.
Diosta tapusha bulltiamusha chi quimsandi puñuucunata tupara. Chasnata tupasha Pedrota nira, Puñuunguichu Simon. Shuc ura tupullatas nicchariashami chapanata manachu usharangui.

Niccharishcashina yuyarichi. Dioshuan cuintasha causaichi ima jucha yuyai shamucpihuas chita ama rangahua, mana ali rana yuyai shamucpi ima tintais tucungahua. Canguna yuyai alita ranata munagllaita canguna aicha randi sambayashcashina mana ahuantacchan nira.
Chasna rimasha cutillata Yaya Diosta tapungahua rira. Pai ñaupa tapushca shimigunallata mañara.
Chiguna tiyaushcama cuti bulltiamusha ricucpi yapa puñunayauta tupara. Chasna asha ima rimanatas mana ushanaurachu.
Quimsa (3) cutin bulltiamusha paigunata nira, Charachu puñuunguichi. Basta puñushcanguichi. Cunanga juchayuc runaguna maquibi japitucuni.
Jatarisha jacuichi. Ñáucata japichingarauc runa caibimi nira.
Jesusta japishcaunamanda

Jesus rimaushcai Judas pactamura. Paiga Jesus chunga ishcai (12) japishca muntunmanda mara. Paihuan ashca runa shamunaura caspigunahuan espada sauligunahuan. Israel pagri amugunas, Moises mandashcagunata yachachiccunas, israelgunata mandaucunahuas chi runa muntunda cachashcauna ara.
Judas paigunata rimashca ara, Ñáuca muctishca runa paimi nisha, paita japisha sinzhita huatasha apanguichi nira.
Chasna acpi Jesuspagma Judas caillayasha paita, Ñáuca yachachic, nisha muctira.
Mucticpi chi shuccuna Jesusta japisha huatanaura.
Jesushuan tiyaucunamanda shucca espada saulita japisha pagriguna amuta cuirac runahua rinrita chiú pitira.
Jesus chi shamuc muntungunata nira, Shuhuac runachani canguna caspigunahuan sauligunahuan ñucata japingahuaca shamunguichi.
Caran punzha Diosta alabana huasibimi cangunahuan tiyaurani cangunata yachachisha. Chasna agllaita mana japihuaranguichichu. Chasna tucuunmi Diospa shimi pactaringahuaca nishami rimara.
Ñáa Jesusta japinaupi paihuan tiyaccuna manzharisha paita saquisha miticunaura.
Jesusta catiu shuc musuga toallahuan pillurishca autas japinaura.
Randi paihua toallata saquisha lluchu llushpirisha mutyu balunllahuan callpara.
Israel amuguna ñaupacpi Jesus shayarin
Jesusta pagriguna amuhuagma pushanaura. Chibimi ashca pagri amuguna, israelgunata mandac rucugunahuas, Moises mandashcata yachachiccunahuas tandarishca anaura.
Pedro carullai catisha rira huasi canzhagama. Chibi auc sundalugunahuan pariu nina cuchui tiyarira cunungahua.
Chi pagri amuguna tucui taripaccunandi Jesusta huanchinata munasha shuc paita caudsayachingahua rimacta mascanaura. Randi mana tupanaurachu.
Ashca runaguna Jesusmanda llullasha rimaushahuas paiguna rimashcaga caran tunu mara.
Puchucaibi ishcai (2) runaguna llullasha casna rimanaura, Ñáucanchi pai rimashcata uyaranchi casna nisha,
Ñáuca cai Diosta alabana huasita runa rashcata tulashami, quimsa (3) punzhaibi shucta mana runa rashcatashina shayachishami nishami nira ninaura.
Chasna rimagllaita mana shuc yuyaillahuanzhu anaura.
Chasna rimaunaupi pagri jatun amu tucuiguna ñaupacpi shayarisha Jesusta tapura, Paiguna rimashcamanda imatata ningui can. Imangahuata cai tucuita canmanda rimagllaita mana rimangui.
Jesusca chunlla aura mana imatas rimasha. Chasna chunlla acpi pagri jatun amu cutillata tapura, Sirtu Quishpichic Cristochangui, balic Diospa Churichangui.
Chita tapucpi Jesus rimara, Indá, chi mani. Shuc punzha ricuhuangaraunguichi ushac Dioshuan pariu ñuca tiyaushcata ñuca puyuguna jahuai shamuuctas ricuhuangaraunguichi nira.
Chita uyasha pagri amu piñarisha paihua quiquin llachapata liquisha rimara, Imangahuata shuc rimacta munanchi.
Cangunallata pai jiridsa shimita rimashcata uyashcanguichi, cunanga imatata ninguichi. Tucuiguna shugllashina caudsayachisha rimanaura, Paiga huañuna man.

Shuccuna tiyaucuna paita tiucangahua callarinaura. Paihua ñahuita tapasha huactasha paita tapunaura, Rimai, pita canda huactara. Chihuasha chi sundalugunahuas paita ucuma apasha paihua ñahuibi huactanaura.
Pedro paita mana ricsinichu nisha rimashcamanda

Chasna Jesus huasi ucui aupi Pedro canzhai tiyaura. Shuc huarmi pagriguna jatun amuhuacpi tarabac huarmi shamusha Pedrota nina cuchui tiyauta ricusha nira, Cambas Nazaretmanda Jesushuan puric arangui.
Pedro randi, Chi runata mana ricsinichu nira, can rimashcata mana intindinichu. Chasna rimasha llucshina pungu mayanbi riushcai gallo cantara.
Chi tarabac huarmi Pedrota chibi ricusha chi shuc tiyaucunata nira, Chi runa Jesuspa muntunmandami.
Pedro cutillata rimara, Mana paihua muntunmandachani. Unanigllai chibi tiyaucuna Pedrota rimanaura, Sirtumi can Jesuspa muntunmanda angui, Galilea llacta rimacshina mangui.
Pedro piñarisha jiridsata rimangahua callarira, Canguna rimaushca runataga mana ricsinichu nira.

Chi ratullai gallo cutillata cantara. Pedro chita uyasha Jesus rimashcata yuyarira, gallo chara mana ishcai (2) cutin cantagllaita can quimsa (3) cutin paita mana ricsinichu nisha ñucamanda rimanguimi, nisha rimashcata yuyarisha yapa ashcata huacangahua callarira.
